// This file defines the directories to scan for files that should be displayed in Document Manager.
// Note: The file should be Unicode and not ASCII format.
// The format of each line is <DirectoryPathAndFileNamePattern>|<IncludeSubdirectories>
// <DirectoryPathAndFileNamePattern> = A relative or absolute path and file name pattern.
//   A relative model subdirectory would be specified using a leading full stop.
//   The file name pattern supports the standard ? and * wildcards.
// <IncludeSubdirectories> = true to include subdirectories and false to not include subdirectories.
// For example: .\Plotfiles\*.pdf|false
  
.\Plotfiles\*.pdf|false
.\CAD\*.dxf|false
.\CAD\*.dwg|false
.\Reports\*.pdf|false
.\Reports\*.xsr|false
.\Reports\*.html|false
.\Reports\*.xls|false
.\Reports\*.Excel|false
.\DSTV_Plates\*.nc1|false
.\DSTV_Profiles\*.nc1|false
.\NC_dxf\*.dxf|false
